ne23987c4a1.headline: GridBeyond Acquires Veritone’s Energy Business
ne23987c4a1.summary: Houston-based smart energy company GridBeyond has announced the acquisition of the energy business of Veritone, a company known for AI software. Terms were not given in the summary.
ne23987c4a1.why: Veritone is a US software company, and its energy unit's sale reflects consolidation in energy-management software.

n863a052fe2.headline: NATO will boost defense spending to help back Ukraine but the math is tricky. Just ask Luxembourg
n863a052fe2.summary: NATO leaders are set to make a new defense spending pledge at their summit this week, as support for Ukraine strains members' military budgets, KPRC reports.
n863a052fe2.why: NATO defense spending commitments shape government budgets and the outlook for defense contractors across member states.

n9e5b693dbd.headline: BioSenic provides further update on negotiations with its main creditors
n9e5b693dbd.summary: BioSenic has signed an agreement with its main creditors for a standstill running until October 2023. The Belgian company provided a further update on its negotiations with lenders.
n9e5b693dbd.why: A standstill gives a financially stressed company time to negotiate with creditors and avoid immediate default, which matters for its shareholders and bondholders.

naf5dd6f09e.headline: Old Mutual :  S&P Global Ratings affirm OMLACSA’S credit rating
naf5dd6f09e.summary: S&P Global Ratings has affirmed the global and national credit ratings of Old Mutual Life Assurance Company Limited. The announcement was made to noteholders.
naf5dd6f09e.why: Old Mutual is a major South African financial services group, and credit ratings affect its borrowing costs and investor confidence in its debt.

nd67712d7ea.headline: Dundee Precious Metals Delivers Strong Second Quarter Gold Production; Announces Timing of Second Quarter Financial Results
nd67712d7ea.summary: Dundee Precious Metals reported preliminary second-quarter gold production from its mines and smelter for the three and six months ended June 30, 2023. It also announced the timing of its Q2 financial results.
nd67712d7ea.why: Dundee Precious Metals is a Toronto-based gold miner, and its production volumes drive its revenue and cash flow.

n41d67f7709.headline: Gov’t pays US$6m of US$13 million debt to WAPCo after cutting gas supply
n41d67f7709.summary: Ghana's government has paid over US$6 million to the West African Gas Pipeline Company (WAPCo) toward a US$13 million debt, after gas supply to the country was cut.
n41d67f7709.why: West African Gas Pipeline Company supplies natural gas to power generation in several West African countries, so payment disputes affect energy supply and utility finances.

n23ab1aebec.headline: 11 foreign companies left Serbia over night
n23ab1aebec.summary: Turkish factory Jeanci is the 11th consecutive foreign company to leave Serbia almost overnight, notifying workers of job terminations by text message. Jeanci promised to pay owed salaries and help workers find jobs.
n23ab1aebec.why: Foreign direct investment in manufacturing supports employment and export capacity, so sudden exits signal investor confidence problems.

source.name: Serbian Monitor – Serbia: notizie di economia, politica, cultura e società

sources.name: Serbian Monitor – Serbia: notizie di economia, politica, cultura e società

n4cce62f820.headline: Israel's judicial reform edges ahead despite protests
n4cce62f820.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is pressing ahead with a judicial overhaul despite renewed protests. His coalition is due to bring a bill limiting the reasonableness standard for judicial review to a first parliamentary reading.
n4cce62f820.why: Changes to Israel's judiciary affect investor confidence in the country's legal and regulatory framework. Political instability can influence the shekel and the cost of Israeli sovereign debt.

ne21c3210be.headline: Helping South Africans save in National Savings Month
ne21c3210be.summary: South Africa's household saving ratio dropped to 0% in the fourth quarter of 2022, an improvement on a decade-long trend that has been largely negative since 2006. The item is part of National Savings Month messaging.
ne21c3210be.why: The household saving ratio measures how much income households set aside, which influences consumer spending and domestic credit demand.

nc34cdc2d3e.headline: India Inc Faces Steep Decline In Deal Volumes, Values Amid Economic Challenges
nc34cdc2d3e.summary: India Inc recorded only 676 deals worth $23 billion in January to June, a steep decline amid economic challenges. Startups and larger companies both saw the drop.
nc34cdc2d3e.why: Deal volumes reflect corporate appetite for mergers, acquisitions and investment, a useful gauge of economic confidence and capital flows.

nc8ce833ad1.headline: Honeywell to Acquire SCADAfence, Strengthening its Cybersecurity Software Portfolio
nc8ce833ad1.summary: Honeywell has agreed to acquire SCADAfence, a provider of operational technology and Internet of Things security software, to strengthen its cybersecurity portfolio.
nc8ce833ad1.why: Honeywell is a diversified US industrial conglomerate, and acquisitions in industrial cybersecurity expand its software and automation offerings.

impacts.name: Honeywell
impacts.why: Honeywell is the buyer and takes on SCADAfence's cybersecurity software business.

n0e0bd87f4c.headline: CMS:  CEWE Stiftung & Co. KGaA
n0e0bd87f4c.summary: CEWE Stiftung & Co. KGaA published its second interim report on its share buy-back programme, according to a MarketScreener post-admission duties announcement.
n0e0bd87f4c.why: Share buy-backs reduce the number of shares outstanding and are a capital-return tool for listed German companies.

ne72e6c5dfd.headline: Czech companies eager to take part in post-war reconstruction of Ukraine
ne72e6c5dfd.summary: Hundreds of Czech companies are eager to engage in Ukraine's post-war reconstruction, with a delegation heading to Kyiv to explore opportunities.
ne72e6c5dfd.why: Reconstruction efforts in Ukraine represent significant business opportunities and economic stimulus for regional companies and markets.

ncf54720db8.headline: Ten SME opportunities with Kina devaluation
ncf54720db8.summary: Papua New Guinea’s planned Kina devaluation creates challenges but also opportunities for SMEs to tap into sectors earning foreign exchange.
ncf54720db8.why: Currency devaluation affects trade competitiveness and can stimulate or hinder small and medium enterprise growth.

nab8d249642.headline: Nigeria to Destroy Tanker Caught Smuggling Crude Oil
nab8d249642.summary: Nigeria’s state oil company intercepted an 800,000-liter vessel carrying stolen crude oil offshore, which will be destroyed.
nab8d249642.why: Crude oil theft impacts Nigeria's oil revenue and regional energy markets, influencing supply and security concerns.

n97c36da2f2.headline: Channel subsidy to the poor - Anglican Bishop tells Tinubu
n97c36da2f2.summary: The Anglican Bishop in Nigeria called on President Tinubu to channel subsidy funds towards poverty alleviation efforts.
n97c36da2f2.why: Government subsidy policies influence fiscal spending, social welfare, and economic stability in Nigeria.

n4c8b442d71.headline: European Union, New Zealand sign free trade deal that's expected to boost trade by up to 30 per cent - OrissaPOST
n4c8b442d71.summary: The European Union and New Zealand signed a free trade deal expected to increase bilateral trade by up to 30%.
n4c8b442d71.why: Trade agreements can enhance exports, economic growth, and market access for involved countries.

source.name: Odisha News, Odisha Latest news, Odisha Daily - OrissaPOST

sources.name: Odisha News, Odisha Latest news, Odisha Daily - OrissaPOST

ne0c6e2614f.headline: Sensex, Nifty end higher on gains led by RIL; mid, smallcaps underperform | Stock Market News
ne0c6e2614f.summary: India's Sensex rose 64 points to 65,344.17 and Nifty gained 24 points to 19,355.90, led by gains in Reliance Industries.
ne0c6e2614f.why: Sensex and Nifty are key Indian stock indices; Reliance Industries is a major index constituent and market mover.

impacts.name: Sensex
impacts.why: Gains in Reliance Industries helped lift the Sensex and Nifty indices.

ne0c6e2614f.why_moved: Reliance Industries' gains drove the broader market indices higher.

n5c03d4105f.headline: New IHG and Recha Estate partnership grows Hotel Indigo brand in Thailand
n5c03d4105f.summary: InterContinental Hotels Group and Recha Estate announced a partnership to grow the Hotel Indigo brand, including a 250-room property opening in Bangkok in 2026.
n5c03d4105f.why: Hotel expansions reflect growth in tourism and hospitality sectors, impacting regional economic activity and investment.

n4e55b23614.headline: Decision on whether next of kin should pay tax arrears of deceased to be known in September
n4e55b23614.summary: Malaysia will determine by September whether next of kin must pay tax arrears of deceased persons.
n4e55b23614.why: Tax liability rules affect estate planning, fiscal revenues, and legal clarity for taxpayers.

n64e5ebaeee.headline: Meralco rates down in July
n64e5ebaeee.summary: Manila Electric Co. (Meralco) reduced electricity rates for households in July, easing consumer costs.
n64e5ebaeee.why: Lower electricity rates can boost household disposable income and consumer spending in the Philippines.

n876e9846cf.headline: Axiata CEO outlines debt reduction strategy
n876e9846cf.summary: Malaysia’s Axiata Group reviews strategies to reduce its debt, aiming to strengthen its financial position.
n876e9846cf.why: Debt management is crucial for telecom companies' creditworthiness and investment appeal.

n0f8fcb5fb2.headline: Smart & Safe campaign collects enough signatures to get recreational marijuana on the ballot
n0f8fcb5fb2.summary: The Smart & Safe Florida campaign, funded by Trulieve, has gathered over one million signatures to legalize recreational marijuana in Florida.
n0f8fcb5fb2.why: Legalization efforts can impact local cannabis companies and related markets, influencing investor sentiment and regulatory outlooks.

n7900f3a336.headline: Debt amnesia for farmers
n7900f3a336.summary: The Philippines' law forgiving debts of 610,000 agrarian reform farmers aims to support rural income and agricultural productivity.
n7900f3a336.why: Debt relief for farmers can boost agricultural output and rural economic stability, affecting food supply and local markets.

nb481dbb120.headline: Coinbase shares up 50% since SEC lawsuit
nb481dbb120.summary: Coinbase's stock has increased significantly since the SEC filed a securities violation lawsuit in the US.
nb481dbb120.why: The rise reflects investor confidence or speculation despite regulatory challenges for the cryptocurrency exchange.

nce7992f04b.headline: Abu Dhabi Secrets: The Emirati 'smear campaign' explained
nce7992f04b.summary: An investigation reveals the UAE conducted a smear campaign targeting individuals and organizations linked to the Muslim Brotherhood.
nce7992f04b.why: Geopolitical tensions and diplomatic actions can influence regional stability and foreign investment flows.

n2826db07b7.headline: Koko urges Marcos to address water shortage in SONA
n2826db07b7.summary: Philippine President Marcos is called to prioritize long-term water infrastructure measures amid recurring shortages.
n2826db07b7.why: Water infrastructure investments are vital for economic stability and public health in the Philippines.

ndb8c218603.headline: Extreme heat will cost the U.S. $1 billion in health care costs — this summer alone » Yale Climate Connections
ndb8c218603.summary: High temperatures are expected to lead to increased ER visits and hospital admissions for heat-related conditions in the US.
ndb8c218603.why: Heat-related health costs reflect the economic impact of climate change and can influence public health policy.

n1f778be0e7.headline: In the news today: Premiers meet to discuss new health care money, Trudeau in Latvia
n1f778be0e7.summary: Canadian provincial premiers meet to discuss the allocation and use of new health care funds, affecting regional budgets.
n1f778be0e7.why: Government spending decisions can influence regional economic activity and public sector employment.

n9d96e491a3.headline: Endless debt
n9d96e491a3.summary: Every baby born in Pakistan is estimated to carry over Rs200,000 in national debt, reflecting the country's debt burden.
n9d96e491a3.why: High national debt levels can impact economic stability, inflation, and investor confidence in Pakistan.

n61d173e3eb.headline: Mendus AB: Report from the extraordinary general meeting of Mendus AB (publ) on 10 July 2023
n61d173e3eb.summary: Mendus AB's extraordinary general meeting approved new resolutions, details to be disclosed later.
n61d173e3eb.why: Corporate governance decisions can influence company valuation and investor confidence.
